items.title: CVE-2026-129448
items.summary: Deserialization of Untrusted Data in Apache Roller versions 4.0.0 through 6.1.4 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code. The XML-RPC endpoint accepts vendor extension types and deserializes them before authenticating the requester. This is the same vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384, which listed only Apache Roller 6.1.5 as affected. This issue is being actively exploited. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.6 or later, which disables the extension types and rejects XML-RPC requests when the XML-RPC feature is disabled. Users who cannot upgrade right…

items.title: CVE-2024-10441: Synology DiskStation Manager remote code execution in system plugin daemon (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) and BeeStation OS (BSM) have a flaw in the system plugin daemon, caused by improper encoding or escaping of output, that lets an attacker run arbitrary code. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in, and the bug is listed as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-90817: Vanderbilt University REDCap remote code execution in survey routing (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. REDCap, from Vanderbilt University, has a flaw in its survey routing and data import handling that lets an attacker run their own code on the server by sending crafted web requests, remotely and without logging in, as long as they know a valid public survey hash. This bug is listed by CISA as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-40217: LiteLLM remote code execution via guardrails test endpoint (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. LiteLLM from BerriAI has a flaw that lets an attacker run arbitrary code on the server by abusing bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code endpoint. It can be reached remotely over the network with only a low-privilege login, and it is listed by CISA as exploited in attacks.

items.title: Critical Apache HTTP Server RCE Vulnerability Actively Exploited in Attacks
items.summary: Apache’s HTTP/2 module, mod_http2, has a critical flaw tracked as CVE-2026-119618 that reportedly allows unauthenticated remote code execution. items.title: CVE-2016-8869: Privilege escalation via user registration (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. The Users component in Joomla! has a flaw in its registration code that lets remote attackers gain privileges by misusing unfiltered data submitted when registering on a site. Attackers can reach it over the network without logging in or any user action, and public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available.

items.title: CVE-2026-59309: VMware authentication bypass in VMware Directory Service (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. VMware vCenter, which is also part of products such as Cloud Foundation, vSphere Foundation, Telco Cloud Infrastructure and Telco Cloud Platform, has a flaw in its VMware Directory Service that lets an attacker bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in, and public exploit code is available.

items.title: CVE-2025-57819: endpoint remote code execution via SQL injection in admin panel (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Attackers are exploiting a flaw in the FreePBX endpoint module, which lets anyone reach the FreePBX Administrator over the network without logging in. From there they can change the database at will and run code remotely, potentially with root-level access.

items.title: CVE-2026-115731: Perforce Puppet Enterprise remote code execution in report deserialization (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Puppet Server's report-processing code is affected by a deserialization flaw that lets a client holding a CA-signed agent certificate run arbitrary code on the server as its service user. If the certificate authority autosigns requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker could obtain such a certificate and exploit this.

items.title: CVE-2026-83548: SonicWall SMA1000 pre-auth SSRF in Work Place interface (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A server-side request forgery flaw in the Work Place interface of the SonicWall SMA1000 appliance lets an attacker reach sensitive functionality and perform unauthorized operations, because of an unintended alternate access path. It can be exploited remotely without logging in, and it is being used in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-90436: Apache Axis remote class instantiation in SOAP fault parsing (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Apache Axis 1.x, an end-of-life SOAP engine for Java, is affected. An attacker can remotely instantiate arbitrary classes, which can lead to code execution on the server, by sending a crafted SOAP fault, and this works without logging in, since the fault is parsed before any service authentication handlers run.

items.title: CVE-2026-130759
items.summary: Fleet from 4.71.0 before 4.88.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the SAML SSO callback that looks up sessions using unvalidated client-supplied identifiers. Users able to run live queries or enroll secret holders can plant attacker-controlled identity provider metadata in the session store, then present a self-signed SAML response to log in as a global admin.

items.title: CVE-2026-71425
items.summary: Outstatic is a static site CMS for Markdown and MDX content stored in GitHub repositories. Prior to 2.2.1, the authenticated GitHub REST proxy accepts an unvalidated endpoint value, constructs an upstream URL by string concatenation, and attaches the current dashboard user's GitHub OAuth token without ensuring the destination remains the exact GitHub API origin. An authenticated dashboard user can cause the server to send that user's token to a non-GitHub host, potentially exposing private repositories and other resources allowed by the token's scopes. The issue does not let an unauthenticated…

items.title: CVE-2026-130754
items.summary: All versions of LaraDashboard contain an authentication bypass in SocialAuthService::findOrCreateUser(), which links a social login to an existing account by email without checking that the OAuth provider verified that email. Unauthenticated attackers using an OAuth/OIDC provider that asserts a victim's email can log in as any user, including Superadmin, and keep persistent access through a linked social_accounts entry.

items.title: CVE-2026-128666
items.summary: A Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in PHPGurukul News Portal Project V4.1. The $currenturl variable in news-details.php is constructed using unencoded REQUEST_URI and HTTP_HOST server variables and echoed directly into the href attributes of social share links. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this by crafting a URL containing HTML metacharacters to break out of the href attribute and execute arbitrary HTML or JavaScript in the context of the victim's browser.

items.title: CVE-2026-126822
items.summary: Description: When BIG-IP APM is provisioned, an Access Profile is configured as a SAML SP (Service Provider) and is applied to a virtual server, undisclosed requests can cause the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM) to terminate. Impact: Traffic is disrupted while the TMM process restarts. This vulnerability allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the BIG-IP system. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only. Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

items.title: CVE-2026-109857
items.summary: CAST Imaging is vulnerable to authentication bypass in the TenantFilter class. The TenantFilter processes the X-ISSUER-LOCATION HTTP header and dynamically registers an OpenID Connect issuer based on its value. An unauthenticated remote attacker can register a malicious identity provider, create users matching existing administrative usernames, and obtain valid JWTs which will be accepted by the application. This results in complete authentication bypass and privilege escalation to administrative access. The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versi…

items.title: CVE-2026-130695
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows holders of revoked OAuth access tokens to authenticate as first-party sessions by presenting them through the session header. Attackers can bypass revocation, client-existence, route allowlist and granted_resources scope checks to modify victim profiles, upload to storage, and force global sign-outs.

items.title: CVE-2026-130730
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows OAuth token holders to act as full sessions because OAuth access tokens are signed with the instance JWT secret. Attackers can present a narrowly scoped OAuth token to the session strategy, short-lived-token exchange, or NocoSocket handshake to gain the granting user's full privileges.

items.title: Two Critical NGINX HTTP/2 Flaws Could Allow Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
items.summary: F5 has disclosed two critical vulnerabilities in NGINX, CVE-2026-123633 and CVE-2026-123007, both in the HTTP/2 module (ngx_http_v2_module). items.title: CVE-2026-55169 | OSC Open OnDemand up to 4.1.5/4.2.2 Dashboard sessions_helper.rb authentication replay
items.summary: A vulnerability identified as critical has been detected in OSC Open OnDemand up to 4.1.5/4.2.2 . items.title: TR-104 - Critical Memory Corruption in OpenJDK Base64 Decoder (Java4Shell, CVE-2026-114938)
items.summary: Introduction On 17 November 2026, OpenJDK and Oracle published security updates addressing CVE-2026-114938, commonly referred to as Java4Shell. The vulnerability is a heap-based out-of-bounds write in the x86-64 hardware-accelerated Base64 decoder of the HotSpot Java Virtual Machine (JVM). Specially crafted Base64 input can corrupt Java heap memory and, under exploitable application conditions, enable information disclosure, denial of service or remote code execution (RCE) without authentication. The vulnerability was reported by Calif and affects a shared Java runtime component rather than a…

items.title: CVE-2026-107099
items.summary: The Royal Addons for Elementor WordPress plugin before 1.7.1071 does not restrict or validate the post meta keys used when counting or rendering a filtered grid, and does not reject private (hidden) meta keys, allowing unauthenticated users to disclose the value of arbitrary private post meta one value at a time from the filtered result count. items.title: CVE-2021-4473: Tianxin Internet Behavior Management System unauthenticated command injection in Reporter endpoint (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Tianxin Internet Behavior Management System from Beijing Topsec Network Security Technology Co., Ltd. has a command injection flaw in its Reporter component endpoint. A remote attacker without logging in can run arbitrary commands by sending a crafted objClass parameter, which lets them write malicious PHP files into the web root and gain remote code execution with the web server's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2025-40553: SolarWinds Web Help Desk remote code execution through deserialization (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a deserialization flaw that lets an attacker run commands on the host machine. The attack can be launched remotely over the network without logging in.

items.title: CVE-2020-4450: IBM WebSphere Application Server remote code execution via deserialization (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. IBM WebSphere Application Server versions 8.5 and 9.0 traditional are affected. A remote attacker can run arbitrary code on the system by sending a specially crafted sequence of serialized objects, and can do so without logging in.

items.title: CVE-2016-0638: Oracle Fusion Middleware unauthenticated remote compromise in WebLogic Server JMS (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. An unspecified flaw in the Oracle WebLogic Server component of Oracle Fusion Middleware, related to Java Messaging Service, lets remote attackers affect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system. The flaw can be reached remotely, without logging in and without any action from a user.

items.title: CVE-2026-131061: Google Chrome remote code execution in Color (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Buffer overflow in Color in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

items.title: CVE-2026-130971: Google Chrome remote code execution in ANGLE (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Out of bounds write in ANGLE in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

items.title: CVE-2026-130994: Google Chrome remote code execution in WebGL outside sandbox (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Use after free in WebGL in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

items.title: CVE-2026-130996: Google Chrome remote code execution in ANGLE (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Out of bounds write in ANGLE in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

items.title: CVE-2026-131025: Google Chrome remote code execution in ANGLE (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. An out-of-bounds read in ANGLE in Google Chrome lets a remote attacker potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox. The attacker does this with a crafted HTML page.

items.title: CVE-2026-131031: Google Chrome remote code execution outside sandbox in GPU (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Google Chrome contains an out-of-bounds write flaw in its GPU component. A remote attacker could exploit it by luring a user to a crafted HTML page, potentially running arbitrary code outside the browser's sandbox.

items.title: CVE-2026-131054: Google Chrome remote code execution in ANGLE (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Out of bounds write in ANGLE in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Critical)

items.title: CVE-2026-131057: Google Chrome possible remote code execution in ANGLE (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Out of bounds read in ANGLE in Google Chrome on on Android prior to 158.0.8127.36 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

items.title: CVE-2026-131077: Google Chrome remote code execution in Tint via out-of-bounds write
items.summary: A flaw in Tint, a component of Google Chrome, lets an attacker write data outside the intended memory bounds, which could allow them to run their own code outside the browser's sandbox. The attacker can reach it remotely, without logging in, by getting a user to open a specially crafted web page.

items.title: Zero Trust Basics for Complex Modern Systems - Rob Allen - ASW #409
items.summary: Orgs don't have to wait for the next zero-day, the next batch of 1,000 CVEs, or the next exploit in the wild to harden their defenses. Rob Allen talks about turning an expectation of "assume breach" into proactive defenses based on zero trust. We also discuss why "assume breach" doesn't have to be a pessimistic stance or even one that presumes malicious intent. After all, with so many agents being adopted throughout an org, restricting access and adding observability reduces the side-effects of agents taking actions you didn't expect regardless of what they were prompted to do. This segment is…

items.title: CVE-2019-19006: Authentication bypass in admin web interface (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Sangoma FreePBX has an access control flaw that lets an attacker bypass authentication on the admin web interface, which could lead to rogue admin accounts, exposure of extension secrets and misuse of the phone system. It can be reached remotely, without logging in, mainly on systems whose admin portal is exposed to the internet, and attacks are happening, since it is listed in CISA's Known Exp...

items.title: “Java4Shell”: Critical OpenJDK Base64 Decoder Flaw Could Allow Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
items.summary: A critical vulnerability dubbed “Java4Shell” (CVE-2026-114938) has been reported in OpenJDK. According to early reports, it lets unauthenticated attackers achieve remote code execution by sending a crafted Base64 string to a Java application running on x86 servers with AVX-512 support. Early reports rate it 9.2 under CVSS 4.0. Java runs a large share of enterprise […] The post “Java4Shell”: Critical OpenJDK Base64 Decoder Flaw Could Allow Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution appeared first on Orca Security .

items.title: CVE-2026-102764: BeyondTrust Remote Support authentication bypass in internal messaging components (Update: Metasploit module published)
items.summary: Update: Metasploit module published. BeyondTrust Remote Support has a flaw in its internal messaging components, which do not properly check where messages come from, so an attacker can perform file operations on the appliance. The attacker can reach it remotely, without logging in or any user interaction, and attacks using this flaw are happening.

items.title: CVE-2021-3199: ONLYOFFICE Document Server remote code execution via directory traversal in upload (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. ONLYOFFICE Document Server, when JWT is used, has a directory traversal flaw in its image upload feature that lets an attacker run code on the server by putting a "/.." sequence in an upload parameter. It can be exploited remotely without logging in, and it is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-116779: SignalWire FreeSWITCH command injection via inbound SIP MESSAGE requests (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. FreeSWITCH, from signalwire, can be attacked remotely without logging in by sending a crafted SIP MESSAGE that selects the api chat protocol, letting an attacker run FreeSWITCH API commands, including arbitrary operating-system commands, with the privileges of the FreeSWITCH process, as well as disclose configuration and credentials and take full call control. Public exploit code exists, and th...

items.title: CVE-2026-132754 | MediaArea MediaInfoLib up to 26.9 Mpeg4 File_Mpeg4::meta_iloc out-of-bounds
items.summary: A vulnerability categorized as problematic has been discovered in MediaArea MediaInfoLib up to 26.9 . The affected element is the function File_Mpeg4::meta_iloc of the component Mpeg4 . Such manipulation leads to out-of-bounds read. This vulnerability is traded as CVE-2026-132754 . An attack has to be approached locally. There is no exploit available. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component.

items.title: CVE-2026-132750 | Meilisearch up to 1.55.0/1.56.0 filter-parser _geoPolygon memory allocation
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in Meilisearch up to 1.55.0/1.56.0 . It has been classified as problematic . This vulnerability affects the function filter-parser . The manipulation of the argument _geoPolygon leads to uncontrolled memory allocation. This vulnerability is documented as CVE-2026-132750 . The attack can be initiated remotely. There is not any exploit available. Upgrading the affected component is recommended.

items.title: CVE-2026-132756 | Geany up to 2.1.0 os command injection
items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in Geany up to 2.1.0 and classified as problematic . Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality. Performing a manipulation results in os command injection. This vulnerability is cataloged as CVE-2026-132756 . The attack must be initiated from a local position. There is no exploit available.

items.title: CVE-2026-132748 | Vtiger CRM up to 8.4.0 config.inc.php updatedFields code injection
items.summary: A vulnerability classified as problematic was found in Vtiger CRM up to 8.4.0 . This impacts an unknown function of the file config.inc.php . The manipulation of the argument updatedFields results in code injection. This vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-132748 . The attack can be executed remotely. There is not any exploit available.

items.title: CVE-2026-132746 | Vtiger CRM up to 8.4.0 wsapp_map SyncServer.php clientid sql injection
items.summary: A vulnerability described as critical has been identified in Vtiger CRM up to 8.4.0 . The impacted element is an unknown function of the file SyncServer.php of the component wsapp_map . Executing a manipulation of the argument clientid can lead to sql injection. The identification of this vulnerability is CVE-2026-132746 . The attack may be launched remotely. There is no exploit available.

items.title: CVE-2026-64492 | Linux Kernel up to 6.18.38/7.1.3 iio temperature driver tmp006_probe use after free (EUVD-2026-48836)
items.summary: A vulnerability categorized as critical has been discovered in Linux Kernel up to 6.18.38/7.1.3 . This affects the function tmp006_probe of the component iio temperature driver . The manipulation results in use after free. This vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-64492 . The attack is only possible with local access. There is not any exploit available. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component.

items.title: CVE-2026-64488 | Linux Kernel up to 7.1.3 ALSA layout.c snd_ctl_new1 null pointer dereference (EUVD-2026-48832)
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in Linux Kernel up to 7.1.3 . It has been declared as very critical . Affected by this vulnerability is the function snd_ctl_new1 of the file layout.c of the component ALSA . Executing a manipulation can lead to null pointer dereference. The identification of this vulnerability is CVE-2026-64488 . The attack may be launched remotely. There is no exploit available. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

items.title: Vulnerabilities in Node.js and Brotli Affecting Cisco Products: October 2026
items.summary: On October 21, 2026, Node.js announced the availability of fixes for multiple vulnerabilities across the following supported release lines: 22.x, 24.x, and 26.x. These vulnerabilities impact critical operations such as the Brotli decoder, DNS resolution, and TLS certificate validation. The vulnerabilities pose risks for remote code execution and traffic interception. For more information, see Node.js Security Release . The following vulnerabilities have a Security Impact Rating (SIR) of High and are addressed in this advisory: CVE-2026-111497 - Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write; potential rem…

items.title: TR-105 NGINX2ROOT - Remote Code Execution in NGINX and Potential Host Compromise
items.summary: Introduction On 18 November 2026, Xint disclosed NGINX2ROOT, a set of five distinct vulnerabilities in NGINX that can allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute commands with the privileges of an NGINX worker. The researchers also described a separate vulnerability in the Linux kernel’s SCTP subsystem that can be chained with an NGINX compromise to obtain root privileges on the underlying host, including in a demonstrated Docker-container scenario. The broadest NGINX attack surface is CVE-2026-123007, which affects unpatched NGINX installations with HTTP/2 enabled. It has existed in t…
items.source: CIRCL Luxembourg - Computer Incident Response Center Luxembourg Recent News

items.title: 2026-022: Critical vulnerabilities in Nginx
items.summary: On 18 November 2026, F5 published an advisory addressing five vulnerabilities in NGINX that allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute code with the privileges of the NGINX worker process. While researchers managed to successfully demonstrate the use of CVE-2026-123007, no exploitation in the wild has been reported yet. It is recommended to swiftly update NGINX as soon as possible, prioritising internet facing appliances.

items.title: 2026-021: High Severity Vulnerability in Java SE and OpenJDK
items.summary: On 17 November 2026, Oracle and the OpenJDK project released fixes for CVE-2026-114938, a high severity vulnerability in OpenJDK which could lead, under certain circumstances, in unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE). CERT-EU recommends updating vulnerable version of OpenJDK, prioritising internet facing applications.

items.title: CVE-2026-129315
items.summary: Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). In 0.31.0 and earlier, the hosted installer and manual installation instructions set /etc/dokploy to mode 0777, allowing a local non-root user on a shared host to replace root-owned schedule or Traefik configuration directories. Dokploy subsequently consumes those paths as trusted configuration and can execute substituted scheduled-task scripts as root, resulting in local privilege escalation.

items.title: CVE-2026-127222
items.summary: SGLang through 0.5.23, fixed in commit 7b5fb39, contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the POST /load_lora_adapter_from_tensors HTTP endpoint, which lacks the @auth_level(AuthLevel.ADMIN_OPTIONAL) decorator applied to its sibling admin endpoints, allowing unauthenticated network-reachable attackers to invoke it without an API key. Attackers can load a LoRA adapter from attacker-supplied serialized tensors to manipulate the served model, and when combined with a separately documented deserialization bypass, achieve unauthenticated remote code execution as root.

items.title: CVE-2026-128668
items.summary: An Unrestricted File Upload vulnerability in the admin panel of PHPGurukul News Portal Project V4.1 allows authenticated attackers to upload files with arbitrary content by bypassing weak filename extension validation in add-post.php and change-image.php. Although files are renamed with an image extension upon storage, the lack of MIME type and content validation enables content spoofing, storage of malicious markup, and creates a vector for Remote Code Execution (RCE) with server misconfigurations or secondary Local File Inclusion.

items.title: CVE-2026-130753
items.summary: heym before 0.0.142 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the Playwright step-mode node where _resolve_expressions_in_code substitutes workflow values directly into generated Python source. Authenticated non-admin users can craft step field values that break out of string literals to execute arbitrary Python as root inside the backend container.

items.title: CVE-2026-55171
items.summary: Open OnDemand is an open-source high-performance computing portal. Prior to Open OnDemand 4.1.6 and 4.2.3, and prior to ood-ansible 4.2.1, the portal generator defaults OIDCCryptoPassphrase to SHA1(servername), and the templates/ood_portal.yml.j2 role checks a different variable from the documented passphrase setting. Administrators who set ood_oidc_crypto_passphrase can therefore believe a strong secret is configured while the deployment continues to use an attacker-derivable value. In OIDCSessionType client-cookie deployments, an unauthenticated remote attacker can derive the encryption key…

items.title: CVE-2026-59964
items.summary: uftpd is a UNIX FTP and TFTP server. Prior to 2.16, uftpd's compose_path function in src/common.c can overflow the fixed dir[PATH_MAX] stack buffer when the server runs without chroot and prepends the configured home directory to a near-PATH_MAX attacker-supplied path using memmove. A logged-in FTP client, including an anonymous or guest client where enabled, can trigger the out-of-bounds write through commands such as CWD, RETR, STOR, or LIST, causing memory corruption and a reliable service crash. Remote code execution has not been demonstrated. This issue is fixed in version 2.16.

items.title: CVE-2026-75522
items.summary: OpenID4VP is an open-source credential parsing library for SD-JWT VC and mDOC/mDL formats. Prior to 0.8.1, src/trust/ChainBuilder.ts ChainBuilder.tryBuild() terminates chain construction when an attacker-controlled certificate Subject Distinguished Name equals a trusted anchor subject, without verifying cryptographic closure to the anchor public key. A remote unauthenticated attacker can supply a self-signed leaf or intermediate that reuses the trusted Subject Distinguished Name and have credentials signed by the attacker key accepted as issued by the trusted authority. The public src/trust/Tr…

items.title: CVE-2026-110521
items.summary: IBM Engineering AI Hub 1.0.0 through 1.4.0 is vulnerable to cross-site scripting. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to embed arbitrary JavaScript code in the Web UI thus altering the intended functionality potentially leading to credentials disclosure within a trusted session.

items.title: CVE-2026-130785
items.summary: Incus from 7.3.0 before 7.6.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the /dev/incus guest API that allows a process in one container to impersonate another by creating a cgroup named with a forged lxc.monitor. component. Attackers can read the target container's user.* and cloud-init.* configuration and devices, subscribe to its events, mark it ready, and export images across projects.

items.title: CVE-2026-130778
items.summary: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows remote attackers to authenticate as any trusted certificate by appending its public certificate to their presented TLS client chain. Attackers can append the server's or a cluster member's certificate to gain cluster-level access, bypass authorization, modify trust store entries, and influence scriptlet-based authorization decisions.

items.title: CVE-2026-130774
items.summary: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability: rebuilding a never-started unprivileged container makes it boot without a user namespace. Root processes inside the container run as host uid 0, keeping capabilities like sys_module, with no device cgroup restriction, letting them load kernel modules and compromise the host.

items.title: CVE-2026-76088
items.summary: PGPainless is a simple-to-use OpenPGP API based on Bouncy Castle. Prior to 1.7.8 and from 2.0.0 until 2.0.4, pgpainless-sop/src/main/kotlin/org/pgpainless/sop/InlineDetachImpl.kt InlineDetachImpl and pgpainless-core/src/main/kotlin/org/pgpainless/decryption_verification/MessageInspector.kt MessageInspector manually descend PGPCompressedData packets without incrementing or enforcing MAX_LAYER_DEPTH. A remote unauthenticated attacker can supply an untrusted OpenPGP message containing deeply nested compressed packet structures to a downstream application using inline-detach or message inspection,…

items.title: CVE-2026-55505
items.summary: Wavelog is web-based amateur radio logging software. Prior to 3.2.4, the application/controllers/Lotw.php import() workflow passes the lotw_download_url configuration value to curl without scheme validation, accepts file:// content, and writes the response to a predictable path under ./uploads/ that can be retrieved through an unauthenticated HTTP request. A standard user can trigger the LotW import, although changing lotw_download_url normally requires installer administrator access, and related vulnerabilities can remove that prerequisite. The same missing status-validation pattern affects t…

items.title: CVE-2026-111515
items.summary: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.105.0, contain an Improper Authorization in Handler for Custom URL Scheme vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Command Execution and Launch of Phishing Attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-73969
items.summary: AnsibleForms is a self-hosted web application that turns automation into self-service forms. Prior to 6.2.1, AnsibleForms uses a public hard-coded fallback JWT signing secret from server/config/auth.config.js when ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET is unset. An unauthenticated attacker can sign a self-contained token with privileged claims because server/src/auth/auth_jwt.js verifies the signature without reloading the user from the database, and server/src/lib/middleware.js trusts the token's roles and options for authorization. A forged token can therefore be accepted as an administrator session, resulting…

items.title: CVE-2026-76100
items.summary: OwnPay is a self-hosted open-source payment gateway automation platform. In 0.2.0 and earlier, modules/gateways/alipay/AlipayGateway.php fails open when an Alipay callback lacks a signature or the merchant has no configured public key because verify(array $callbackData, array $credentials) falls back to an undefined mode credential that defaults to test mode, while verifyWebhook() returns true unconditionally. An unauthenticated request to POST /webhook/{gateway} can provide a pending order reference and matching amount, pass both verification gates without a valid payment signature, and cause…

items.title: CVE-2026-132232
items.summary: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 remote code execution was possible via argument injection in Perforce settings

items.title: CVE-2026-132231
items.summary: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 remote code execution was possible via best-fit character mapping in Perforce settings

items.title: CVE-2026-130789
items.summary: SemanticMediaWiki from 7.3.0 before 7.4.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the smwtask API check-query task that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass object-level authorization by relying on the wiki-wide edit right. Attackers can supply arbitrary subject titles, including protected pages, to run synchronous Semantic MediaWiki queries with caller-controlled conditions, limit, offset, and querymode parameters.

items.title: CVE-2026-130765
items.summary: Obot before 0.27.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass same-site validation of the rd parameter by inserting a tab character. Attackers can craft sign-in or sign-out links on the Obot domain that browsers resolve to external hosts, redirecting victims to phishing pages.

items.title: CVE-2026-130760
items.summary: Fleet before 4.86.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory via unbounded BER recursion in PKCS#7 parsing. Attackers can send deeply nested indefinite-length structures to Apple MDM check-in, enrollment, SCEP, or OTA endpoints to crash the entire Fleet instance.

items.title: CVE-2026-128662
items.summary: PHPGurukul Employee Leaves Management System V2.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability because database backup files are stored within the publicly accessible web root. An unauthenticated remote attacker can download the SQL backup files and retrieve sensitive database contents, including employee personally identifiable information and password hashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-128661
items.summary: PHPGurukul Employee Leaves Management System v2.1 contains an insufficient verification vulnerability in the password recovery functionality in forgot-password.php. The application allows an unauthenticated user to access the password-change workflow by providing a valid employee ID and corresponding email address without requiring an additional out-of-band verification mechanism.

items.title: CVE-2026-54747
items.summary: Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. Prior to 2.0.3, public/main/course_description/course_description_controller.php assigns contentDescription directly from a teacher's request in the Doctrine-based add and edit paths without cross-site scripting sanitization. The stored value is rendered by src/CoreBundle/Resources/views/Course/about.html.twig through description with raw output, and the /course/{id}/about route is publicly accessible. A teacher can store active content that executes when an authenticated or unauthenticated visitor views the course description, enabling…

items.title: CVE-2026-128664
items.summary: An insecure password reset vulnerability in the Admin Password Recovery Module of PHPGurukul News Portal Project v4.1 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to change an administrator or sub-administrator account password by providing the corresponding username and email address. The application does not require verification of account ownership through an email token, OTP, or another authentication mechanism before updating the password, potentially resulting in account takeover.

items.title: CVE-2026-71499
items.summary: cf-manager is an all-in-one dashboard for managing multiple Cloudflare accounts and services. Prior to 1.1.2, worker/src/routes/workers.ts uses bare fetch(url) calls to retrieve user-supplied URLs and deploys the returned content as a Worker script using stored Cloudflare credentials. The multipart and JSON branches of POST /api/:accountId/workers and POST /api/batch-deploy accept URLs without protocol, destination, redirect, content-type, or response-size validation. An attacker with deployment API access, or unauthenticated access when API_SECRET is not configured, can make cf-manager access…

items.title: CVE-2026-61582
items.summary: Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. Prior to 1.11.40, main/inc/ajax/user_manager.ajax.php exposes the update_users action without an authorization check and stores attacker-controlled firstname, lastname, and email values without HTML sanitization. An unauthenticated attacker can modify another user's profile fields, and the stored content executes when user_portal.php, the administrative user listing, user information, social profile, course participant list, or message-composer recipient header renders the modified account. Targeting an administrator account can expose…

items.title: CVE-2026-76421
items.summary: A vulnerability in the LZX data algorithm for Microsoft Compiled HTML Help (CHM) file scanning in ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device. This vulnerability is due to improper boundary checks when applying the LZX data algorithm to CHM files during the decoder stage, which may result in buffer overflow. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted CHM file for scanning. items.title: CVE-2022-51031
items.summary: PMB 7.3.1 before 7.3.15 and 7.4.x before 7.4.5 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject script through unescaped POST parameter names. Attackers can send crafted parameter names to opac_css/index.php extended_search, which empr.inc.php and languages.inc.php reflect into hidden form inputs to execute JavaScript. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

items.title: CVE-2022-51030
items.summary: QiboCMS V7 contains an arbitrary file download vulnerability in inc/job/download.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to read files by supplying a base64-encoded url parameter to /do/job.php?job=download. Attackers can bypass the .php extension check using the Windows 'ph<' wildcard to download sensitive files such as configuration files containing database credentials. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-18.

items.title: CVE-2022-51029
items.summary: Synway SMG Gateway Management Software builds through 2022-03-15 contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files via the downfile parameter in /down.php. Attackers can send a multipart POST request to /down.php with a traversal path in downfile to retrieve sensitive files like /etc/passwd. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-20.

items.title: CVE-2022-51028
items.summary: CmsEasy 7.7.5_20210919 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the execsql_action function at /?case=crossall&act=execsql that executes attacker-supplied queries decrypted with the hardcoded key 'cmseasy_sql'. Attackers can send a crafted 'sql' parameter to run arbitrary SQL and dump the admin username and password hash. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-22.

items.title: CVE-2021-48027
items.summary: OTOBO 10.0.1 before 10.0.13 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users by supplying arbitrary URLs to the ExternalURLJump action. Attackers can craft GET requests to /otobo/index.pl?Action=ExternalURLJump with a malicious URL parameter, which the ExternalURLJump.pm module redirects to without an allow-list check, enabling phishing attacks. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

items.title: CVE-2021-48026
items.summary: Zhongqing Naboo Education Cloud Platform builds through 2021-07-09 contain a missing authentication vulnerability in the /api/TeacherQuery/SearchTeacherInSiteWithPagerRecords endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to access sensitive teacher data. Attackers can send unauthenticated GET requests to this endpoint to retrieve user names, login names, and admin ids from the JSON response. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-11-15.

items.title: CVE-2021-48025
items.summary: OpenSNS 3.2.1 contains an unauthenticated code injection vulnerability in the shareBox method of ShareController that allows attackers to invoke arbitrary model methods via the query parameter. Attackers can send crafted GET requests to /index.php?s=weibo/Share/shareBox abusing parse_str and ShareModel::getInfo to reach Schedule::runSchedule and execute code through assert. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

items.title: CVE-2021-48022
items.summary: Rocket.Chat versions 0.61.0 before 3.11.4, 3.12.x before 3.12.4 and 3.13.x before 3.13.2 contain a missing authorization vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to read any room's messages via the livechat:loadHistory Meteor method. Attackers can mint a guest token through livechat:registerGuest and send POST requests to /api/v1/method.callAnon with a target rid parameter to retrieve message history without membership checks. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2025-02-13.

items.title: CVE-2021-48021
items.summary: Chamilo LMS 1.11.10 before 1.11.16 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the searchOptionsFromTags function through the options parameter of extra_field.ajax.php. Attackers can send POST requests with a malicious JSON options array to inject SQL into the IN clause and extract database information. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

items.title: CVE-2020-37290
items.summary: Kiwi TCMS before 8.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the User.filter JSON-RPC method that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve user account information. Attackers can send a POST request to /json-rpc/ invoking User.filter with a query parameter to disclose sensitive user data without authentication. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-19.

items.title: CVE-2019-25786
items.summary: Gnuboard5 5.0.1 before 5.3.3.3 and 5.4.0.1 before 5.4.0.2 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through the arr_ajax_msg parameter. Attackers can craft GET requests to /plugin/sms5/ajax.sms_emoticon.php, where common.php's @extract($_GET) injects the value into the echoed JSON output, executing script in victims' browsers. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

items.title: CVE-2019-25784
items.summary: FineCMS versions 5.0.4 before 5.0.11 contain an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the data2 API action handled by list_tag in libraries/Template.php. Attackers can send GET requests to index.php?c=api&m=data2 with a valid auth hash and the param action=sql sql='...' to execute arbitrary SELECT queries and extract database information. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

items.title: CVE-2019-25783
items.summary: Tiny Tiny RSS before commit c68ac04 (2019-03-03) contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users through the unvalidated 'return' parameter. Attackers can craft requests to /public.php?op=login with an absolute external URL in 'return', which is placed in the Location header to send victims to attacker-controlled sites. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2026-02-26.

items.title: CVE-2019-25782
items.summary: ThinkPHP 5.0.0 before 5.0.24 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute commands by setting _method=__construct in POST data to overwrite the Request filter property. Attackers can send POST requests to endpoints reached via ?s=captcha or ?s=index/index/index with filter[]=system and server[REQUEST_METHOD] values to execute arbitrary system commands. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

items.title: CVE-2012-20007
items.summary: ThinkPHP 2.0 through 2.2 and 3.0 Lite mode contains an eval injection vulnerability in the Dispatcher PATH_INFO parsing, which uses preg_replace with the /e modifier and a double-quoted replacement. Unauthenticated attackers can send crafted requests to index.php with a malicious 's' parameter containing PHP expressions to execute arbitrary code on the server. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

items.title: CVE-2010-20126
items.summary: Virtual Keyboard plugin for SquirrelMail through 0.9.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject script by supplying unsanitized input in the passformname parameter. Attackers can craft GET requests to /plugins/vkeyboard/vkeyboard.php with script payloads in passformname to execute code in victims' browsers and steal session cookies. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

items.title: CVE-2026-118521
items.summary: The Toolbox for Asgaros Forum plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the replace_temp_pics function in all versions up to, and including, 1.2.4. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to delete arbitrary files on the server, which can easily lead to remote code execution when the right file is deleted (such as wp-config.php). This vulnerability is only reachable when the site administrator has enabled the Inline Image Upload feature (disabled by default).

items.title: CVE-2026-110009
items.summary: The Unzer Payments plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass leading to Account Takeover in all versions up to, and including, 2.2.1. The vulnerability exists because the Google Pay Express Checkout endpoint (`/?wc-api=google_pay_express`), handled by `startCheckoutDataWithNormalizedCustomerData`, accepts an attacker-controlled `paymentData.email` value and passes it to `createOrGetGuestCustomer()`, which resolves the submitted email to any existing WordPress user via `get_user_by('email', ...)` and then calls `wp_set_current_user()` and `wp_set_auth_cookie()` for the resolve…

items.title: CVE-2026-130750
items.summary: Network-AI from 5.11.0 before 5.17.2 contains a CORS misconfiguration in McpStreamableServer that reflects localhost Origins into Access-Control-Allow-Origin regardless of bind interface. Attackers controlling a localhost-origin page or DNS-rebinding name can read unauthenticated /tools and /health responses, exposing tool catalogs and bridge metadata on non-loopback binds.

items.title: CVE-2026-116446
items.summary: Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an out-of-bounds memory vulnerability in the NAS NFS service that an unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit to cause a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-95787
items.summary: Vulnerabilities in the PAPI protocol of AOS-10 could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to circumvent existing authentication controls. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to gain administrative access, modify system configurations, and access or manipulate sensitive data.

items.title: CVE-2026-130744
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows page editors to escape the Twig sandbox by sending requests with a Host: pages header. Attackers can write configuration YAML through page folders and media .meta.yaml sidecars to register an unsandboxed Twig namespace and run shell commands as the web server user.

items.title: CVE-2026-130675
items.summary: Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.4 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in ImageTransforms::normalizeTransform() that allows attackers to instantiate arbitrary classes by supplying class:null with a __class key. Attackers can reach the method through Craft Commerce's payments/pay redirect template calling customer.photo.getUrl() with a crafted transform to instantiate classes like yii\rbac\PhpManager and execute PHP.

items.title: CVE-2026-132125
items.summary: Weblate 5.0 through 2026.11.2 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability where deleting a component list leaves stale Group.projects rows, widening team scope to whole projects. A user with componentlist.edit who deletes a list grants 'From component list' team members their full role, including project.edit, across possibly private projects.

items.title: CVE-2026-130747
items.summary: Grav before 1.7.53.7 and 2.x before 2.2.18 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows anonymous visitors to create super-admin accounts because UserCollection::count() uses an unescaped glob() pattern. On installs whose path contains brackets or a backslash, the account count returns zero, so attackers can send requests to POST /api/v1/auth/setup or the classic admin registration form to create or overwrite administrator accounts.

items.title: CVE-2026-130736
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows publishers to bypass the media action allowlist using scoped method names in Markdown image URLs. Attackers can chain actions like self::addMetaFile into static calls such as Process::fromShellCommandline to read files and run shell commands as the web server user.

items.title: CVE-2026-107644
items.summary: The Bizuno Accounting – ERP/Accounting/CRM (for WordPress) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass via Password Reset Token Disclosure in all versions up to, and including, 7.4.5 via the `bizUser` parameter of the `validateReset()` function on the `portal/api/lostPW` endpoint. This is due to `portalCtl::goAPI()` failing to call `loadBusinessCache()` before invoking the handler, which causes `isMailConfigured()` to read an empty business cache and return false regardless of the site's actual mail configuration, causing the fully-qualified reset URL — containing the victim's…

items.title: CVE-2026-130749
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to fill the disk by varying the HTTP Host header. Attackers can send requests with distinct Host values to create per-host compiled configuration, blueprint, language and page index caches, causing session, upload and logging failures.

items.title: CVE-2026-130739
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows user managers and Flex editors to overwrite, create, or delete accounts by supplying client-controlled storage keys. Attackers can abuse the create form username, cross-type form flash replay, or __META storage key rename to gain super-admin accounts or delete account files.

items.title: CVE-2026-130738
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows user managers with admin.users.update to take over super admin accounts by disabling the super-granting group. Attackers can set the group's enabled field to false via the Flex user-groups form, then reset the victim's password through the user-accounts form to gain super admin access.

items.title: CVE-2026-130737
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows user managers to grant super-admin rights by nesting access maps under a YAML merge key. Attackers with admin.users.create or api.users.write can submit ', that bypass super-grant filtering and gain full site control.

items.title: CVE-2026-130732
items.summary: Traefik from 2.11.58 before 2.11.61 contains a resource leak vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust resources by sending Authorization headers with NTLM or Negotiate schemes. Attackers can open many short-lived connections that each allocate a dedicated backend transport never released, exhausting memory, file descriptors and backend connections.

items.title: CVE-2026-129961
items.summary: LMS (Lan Management System) is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in its e-mail-based Helpdesk ticket intake. The mail parser does not reject Apache .htaccess configuration files or PHP-executable files when saving ticket attachments. A remote unauthenticated attacker can e-mail a Helpdesk ticket with such an attachment; in the default configuration, anyone can request the uploaded file's URL which executes attacker-supplied code with the privileges of the web server process. No operator interaction or LMS client session is required. The issue was fixed in commit d5059b1.

items.title: CVE-2026-127142
items.summary: LMS (Lan Management System) is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution via unrestricted upload of dangerous file types in the service ticket feature of the client panel. The application does not verify the type or name of files attached to service tickets. An authenticated attacker can upload an .htaccess file to bypass the access restrictions on the storage directory, together with a PHP script. Visiting the uploaded PHP file's URL leads to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the web server. This issue was fixed in commit 89dd3f7.

items.title: CVE-2026-92535
items.summary: The Make Connector plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.6 via the include_custom_fields. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to extract arbitrary admin-selected user, post, comment, and term metadata exposed via core REST endpoints — including active session tokens with source IP, user-agent, login and expiry timestamps, capability sets, and any other admin-selected private meta keys including protected underscore-prefixed entries. This is exploitable because the plugin's meta picker queries all meta key…

items.title: CVE-2026-129323
items.summary: The Masteriyo LMS – LMS Course Builder, Quizzes & Certificates plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'content' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.5.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. On a default install, any unauthenticated visitor can self-register as a Masteriyo Student through the plugin's public /account/signup/ form with…

items.title: CVE-2026-127143
items.summary: LMS (Lan Management System) is vulnerable to privilege escalation in the lmsd daemon. The daemon loads the libraries listed in the LMS database without checking that they come from a trusted location. An attacker with access to the web server process or with write access to the LMS database can register a malicious library and trigger a configuration reload, causing lmsd to load and execute it. Because the example systemd unit does not set a separate user, lmsd runs as root, allowing the attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges. This issue was fixed in commit 89dd3f7. The lmsd c…

items.title: CVE-2026-124977
items.summary: The Flexible PDF Invoices for WooCommerce & WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'billing_address.first_name / extensions.wpdesk-flexible-invoices-checkout._billing_vat_number' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Execution requires an administrator to open the invoice edit page for the attacker's order and interact wit…

items.title: CVE-2026-130682
items.summary: SiYuan before 3.8.10 persists a table block's caption attribute into IAL properties without HTML sanitization, causing stored cross-site scripting upon import or sync. Attackers can inject an entity-encoded caption with an onerror handler that executes in the Electron client's nodeIntegration context to achieve remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-130674
items.summary: Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.4 contains an incomplete blocklist fix that allows attackers who can author entry type title formats to write arbitrary files using ZipArchive or XMLWriter classes. Attackers can abuse the non-sandboxed renderObjectTemplate() renderer to write attacker-controlled content into the web docroot, achieving remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-18553
items.summary: Mattermost versions 11.11.x <= 11.11.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.11, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2 fail to sanitize terminal escape sequences when rendering server logs via {{mmctl logs}}, which allows an unauthenticated attacker to hijack a system administrator's clipboard or spoof terminal output via a crafted HTTP request whose logged content is later viewed with {{mmctl logs}}. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00753

items.title: CVE-2026-109859
items.summary: CAST Imaging has a missing authentication vulnerability in the "/api/auth/keycloak/users/{username}" endpoint. An unauthenticated remote attacker can modify the email address of an arbitrary Keycloak user and access sensitive account information, including the API authentication token hash. This can lead to account takeover, user impersonation and user enumeration. The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

items.title: CVE-2026-19707
items.summary: A bug in the Airlock Gateway (8.5.2 and earlier, and 8.6.0) allows attacker-controlled HTML in a backend response to exploit the Smart Form Protection feature, possibly leading to a Denial of Service (DoS) or Remote Code Execution (RCE) attack against the Airlock Gateway. The issue has been fixed in Airlock Gateway version 8.5.3 and 8.6.1. For an attack to be executable, the Airlock Gateway needs to have 'Smart Form Protection' (or the corresponding expert settings) enabled on a mapping whose backend returns a response containing certain multi-byte HTML character references. The buffer overflo…

items.title: CVE-2026-63189
items.summary: Dialoqbase is an application for creating chatbots. Prior to 1.11.5, the unauthenticated GET /api/v1/view/* route in server/src/routes/api/v1/view/root.ts resolves its attacker-controlled wildcard path without normalization or containment, allowing traversal outside the intended uploads directory and arbitrary server file reads. Reading environment files can disclose DB_SECRET_KEY, the application’s JWT signing key, which permits forged administrator tokens and takeover of bots, conversations, integrations, and stored third-party credentials. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.5.

items.title: CVE-2026-48728
items.summary: The GLPI Inventory Plugin handles network discovery, inventory, software deployment, and data collection for GLPI agents. Prior to 1.6.8, the /b/deploy, /b/collect, and /b/esx agent API endpoints do not authenticate requests before processing Deploy, Collect, and ESX task operations. An unauthenticated remote attacker can enumerate jobs and manipulate their status through these endpoints, disclosing job information and interfering with task processing. This issue is fixed in version 1.6.8.

items.title: CVE-2026-130723
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access attachments of filtered-out records through the shared view attachment-download endpoint. Attackers holding a public share link can enumerate sequential primary keys to obtain signed download paths for files on records the view's row filter excludes.

items.title: CVE-2026-130720
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access records hidden by a shared view's row filter by supplying arbitrary primary keys. Attackers with the share link can request attachment downloads and many-to-many or has-many link listings for excluded records to obtain their attachment files and linked record identities.

items.title: CVE-2026-130719
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated shared-base link holders to read the base's stored plaintext password through the general base metadata endpoint. Attackers with a share link can query the base read or list responses in bases.controller.ts, which skip password stripping in sanitizeBase.ts, to obtain reusable plaintext passwords.

items.title: CVE-2026-130714
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains a user enumeration vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to determine registered email addresses by observing differing sign-up endpoint responses. Attackers can submit addresses to signup in users.service.ts and compare error messages to identify existing accounts and pending Enterprise invitations, even under invite-only signup.

items.title: CVE-2026-130713
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains a user enumeration vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to identify pending invitees through a distinct sign-in error message. Attackers can submit sign-in requests where validateUser in auth.service.ts skips password comparison for saltless invited accounts, confirming the email address has an account.

items.title: CVE-2026-130710
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the job status polling endpoint of jobs.controller.ts that lacks an @Acl decorator. Unauthenticated attackers with a job id can read buffered status messages and completion payloads, exposing signed export download URLs or new base identifiers.

items.title: CVE-2026-130705
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated shared view link holders to read hidden columns by grouping on physical column names. Attackers can supply a hidden column's physical name or the unchecked sub-group parameter to the public group-by endpoint to reveal hidden values, counts, and column existence.

items.title: CVE-2026-130703
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read hidden columns by supplying comma-separated group-by column lists. Attackers with a shared view link can pair a visible and hidden column to bypass restrictSharedViewColumnReferences and retrieve hidden values tied to individual rows.

items.title: CVE-2026-119634
items.summary: The User Frontend – Membership, User Registration, User Profile, User Directory & Content Restriction with Frontend Post Submission plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 4.3.14 via the `draft_post()` function. This is due to the function storing the `post_content` parameter via `wp_insert_post()` without the protected-shortcode allow-list check that was introduced in 4.3.14 for the sibling `submit_post()` handler — a gap that `wp_kses` filtering does not close, as it strips only HTML tags while leaving shortcode text such as `[wpuf-reg…

items.title: CVE-2026-130691
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to download data exports by reconstructing predictable file paths under nc/uploads/data-export. Attackers can derive paths from the table id, base, table and view titles, and export time to read full exports, including fields hidden from public shared views.

items.title: CVE-2026-130685
items.summary: vLLM from 0.28.0 before 0.33.0 contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the shared EngineCore by sending out-of-range prompt token ids when served with --skip-tokenizer-init. Attackers can submit a large positive token id to /v1/completions, /v1/embeddings, or /pooling, bypassing the tokenizer-gated vocab check and causing a fatal embedding index error that denies service to all tenants.

items.title: CVE-2026-130684
items.summary: vLLM before 0.33.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows malicious model publishers to redirect the served model and tokenizer by setting speculators_config verifier.name_or_path in config.json. Attackers can point this field at another local checkpoint directory to leak its tokenizer vocabulary via unauthenticated /detokenize requests and gain query access to private models.

items.title: CVE-2026-130650
items.summary: WWBN AVideo through c3edcc274c389816d434acadac07ee78eaf330c1 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability because the default node socket server relays autoEvalCodeOnHTML without the PHP-only filter. Unauthenticated attackers can obtain an anonymous socket token and send a spoofed MSG_BATCH message to trigger client eval() in administrators' browsers for account takeover.

items.title: CVE-2026-87789
items.summary: Latvijas Valsts radio un televīzijas centrs (LVRTC) eParakstītājs 3.0 version 1.10.0 for macOS allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with the privileges of the current user by convincing the user to open a PDF with a crafted filename and select Send. The application embeds the attachment path in AppleScript source without neutralizing AppleScript syntax, allowing injected do shell script expressions to execute.

items.title: CVE-2026-120049
items.summary: The Link Library plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'linkfile[name]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.10.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires an administrator to have enabled the "Link File" option within the plugin's settings, which activates the vulnerable file upload field on the public add-link form.

items.title: CVE-2016-20105
items.summary: Lucee Server versions 5.0.0.0 before 5.3.4.46 contain an insecure default configuration that allows unauthenticated attackers to set the initial admin password via the first-run form on /lucee/admin/web.cfm and /lucee/admin/server.cfm. Attackers can access the 'New Password' set-password form before any password is configured to seize administrative control of the server. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-24.

items.title: CVE-2026-123417
items.summary: The Check & Log Email – Easy Email Testing & Mail logging plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.17 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires an administrator to open the relevant log entry and click the planted anchor link in the Preview panel, at which point the ThickBox gadget parses the title…

items.title: CVE-2026-3232
items.summary: The Easy Appointments plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'name' and 'phone' fields in all versions up to, and including, 3.12.23.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever an administrator accesses the Customers page.

items.title: CVE-2026-128981
items.summary: ** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** Improper Authentication in Apache SeaTunnel Web 1.0.2 allows a user whose account has been disabled to authenticate with valid credentials and obtain a new login token. The login query does not check the account status, so disabling an account does not prevent new logins or access to protected APIs using the newly issued token. This issue requires valid credentials for the disabled account; it is not a credential-free authentication bypass. Apache SeaTunnel Web is no longer maintained. The affected 1.0.2 release does not contain the account-status check added to…

items.title: CVE-2026-123343
items.summary: The BlockArt Blocks – Gutenberg Blocks, Page Builder Blocks ,WordPress Block Plugin, Sections & Template Library plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 2.4.3. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to view the title, excerpt, and full content of other users' draft, pending, and private posts, exposing that content to unauthenticated visitors on the published permalink. This is exploitable…

items.title: CVE-2026-96665
items.summary: The SendPress Newsletters plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'sp_firstname' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.26.1.20 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The public subscriber-management route uses an unsigned, forgeable base64-encoded JSON token, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to impersonate any subscriber and obtain a valid nonce — bypassing the POST handl…

items.title: CVE-2026-130014
items.summary: The Team VCard generator plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.0 via the 'photo' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to read the contents of arbitrary files on the server, which can contain sensitive information.

items.title: CVE-2026-1214
items.summary: The BuddyPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 14.5.0. This is due to missing authorization checks in the `bp_nouveau_ajax_get_single_activity_content` AJAX handler. The function only verifies a nonce that is publicly exposed to any visitor who loads a BuddyPress page, but does not call `bp_activity_user_can_read()` to verify the user has permission to view the activity. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to read private group activity content by iterating activity IDs.

items.title: CVE-2026-106096
items.summary: A flaw was found in CRI-O. When the optional Linux LinkLogs feature is enabled, the host pod log directory is bind-mounted into a pod emptyDir and is intended to be read-only, but Linux ignores MS_RDONLY on the initial bind and the CRI mount stays writable. A non-privileged UID 0 container can place a symlink at a future kubelet log path so that privileged conmon later appends attacker-controlled log data to an existing host file. This is an append-only host integrity issue, not universal remote code execution; LinkLogs is not enabled by default.

items.title: CVE-2026-131857
items.summary: Supergateway 4.2.0 through 4.2.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in stdio-to-SSE mode that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the gateway via prototype-inherited sessionId values. Attackers can send a POST message request with sessionId set to toString or constructor, triggering an unhandled TypeError that terminates every attached MCP session.

items.title: CVE-2026-131852
items.summary: OwnTracks Recorder before 1.0.5 contains a format string vulnerability in json_response() and related output functions that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute code by storing a malicious tid value. Attackers can publish locations via POST /pub or MQTT with printf specifiers in tid, then read them back through GET /api/0/last to leak addresses and write memory.
